initialExam.title: Goa Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Goa Police Constable recruitment for constable posts in Goa state police force.
initialExam.eligibility: SSC (10th pass) or HSSC (12th pass) from a recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Current Affairs, Goa GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English, Konkani/Marathi.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit goapolice.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension
